Our Story

A small kitchen with a big heart

Foodie's Hub started as a six-table eatery with one karahi burner and a simple promise: serve the food we feed our own family. Twelve years on, the hall is bigger — the promise hasn't changed.

  • Fresh every morning — meat, vegetables and spices bought daily, nothing frozen overnight.
  • Family hall & separate seating — comfortable space for families and small events.
  • Events & daigs — bulk orders and daig booking for weddings and gatherings.
